title: ENB shader map
description: Maps each ENB shaderinput hash to the game shader it replaces, in each shader set under investigation. Identification is separate from confidence on purpose: a candidate with low confidence is a lead, not a fact.

generated.description: ISO date the map was produced

method.description: How candidates were identified, including the tool

shader_sets.description: Named shader sets the entries refer to, each described well enough to reproduce

presets.description: ENB presets the hashes came from

enb_hash.description: The hash in the shaderinput filename, uppercase

role.description: What the shader appears to do, from its code

headline.description: One-paragraph summary of what the map shows.

container_spread.description: How much of a shader package has to be given up to satisfy the identified targets, since a .fxc container is the finest granularity available.

candidate.description: container.fxc#index within that shader set, or empty if none

confidence.description: high/medium/low come from the similarity measure alone. 'confirmed' means a runtime capture showed ENB substituting this shader; nothing else does.

declaration_matched_pool.description: How many candidates survived declaration filtering. 1 with a high similarity is an identification; a large pool with a low one is a lead; 0 means no shader in the set has a compatible signature.
